setup.title: Get started
setup.description: A few steps and {company} runs on its own: tasks go out, people check in, money adds up.
setup.progressBody: Each step takes a minute or two. You can come back to any of them later.
setup.allDoneBody: Everything is in place. Dismiss this checklist whenever you like.
setup.dismissBody: The progress pill leaves the sidebar for everyone in the company. You can open this page from the command palette any time.
setup.emptyBody: There are no setup steps for your role here.
setup.footer: Switch on more modules and their steps appear here.
setup.step.companies_branches.title: Set up your branches
setup.step.companies_branches.body: Address, opening hours and the check-in circle on the map for each shop.
setup.step.companies_invite.title: Invite your staff
setup.step.companies_invite.body: Share the invite link or hang the QR poster: people join from Telegram.
setup.step.companies_modules.title: Choose your modules
setup.step.companies_modules.body: Switch on only what you need: finance, sales, attendance, payroll and more.
setup.step.groups_connect.title: Connect a Telegram group
setup.step.groups_connect.body: The bot posts finished tasks, late ones and the evening summary there.

setup.new.languageHint: Group posts and new staff start in it.
setup.new.codeHint: Your first company needs the code you were given.
setup.new.codeRequired: Enter the signup code you were given.
setup.new.copyHint: Settings only. People, money and history never travel.
setup.new.nothingToCopy: There’s nothing you may copy from that company yet.

setup.new.createdHint: You’re its owner. Let’s set it up.
